1.mascotDialogue: Two ends this time, not one — the front, for leaving, the back, for joining! Mix those up, tesoro, and you have quietly built yourself a stack instead.

2.mascotDialogue: That `% MAX`, on both front and rear — this is what lets the array wrap around, instead of shifting everybody forward every time somebody leaves. Molto elegante.

3.mascotDialogue: FRONT and REAR, two separate markers now! Watch them, they stay two apart as you enqueue, as you dequeue.

4.mascotDialogue: An empty queue, she is not 'nothing to see,' tesoro — she is a specific, checkable state! If your dequeue does not check for her, she will hand you garbage and call it a value, shameless!
